takeaway: Thoracic trachea (C6 to T5) relations. Right: vagus, azygos vein. Anterior: brachiocephalic artery, left common carotid, thymus, left brachiocephalic vein. Posterior: oesophagus, recurrent laryngeal nerves.

lines.text: Which relation of the thoracic trachea is correct?
The trachea runs from the cricoid cartilage at C6 to its split into two main bronchi at T5.
lines.say: The trachea runs from the cricoid cartilage at C six to its split into two main bronchi at T five.

lines.text: On its right lie the vagus nerve and the azygos vein: that's the book's answer.
In front: the brachiocephalic artery, left common carotid, thymus and left brachiocephalic vein.
Behind: the oesophagus and the recurrent laryngeal nerves.
On the left: the aortic arch, left subclavian vein, left recurrent laryngeal nerve and left common carotid.
So, on the right: the azygos vein.
lines.say: (clears throat) So, on the right: the azygos vein.
